title: slider: Simpler default CSS styles
body:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/10601938/7f32efc2-7715-11e5-9e94-518e0e1c2515.png)

Current styles have strong opinion about colors/fonts/size. We should strip it down to the bare usable one in `default.css`.

comments.body: Yes maybe just default to gray background, black font color and this should be enough?
The whole slider CSS code can be simplified I guess. It weight more than all the other widgets combined. But yes, no colors, no rounded borders at least.

Dunno if we need to spend some good time on this because it should still look good with very little styling. And no rounded borders I am not sure it still looks ok.

Our slider will always be the most styled widget because making it very generic and usable without too much styling is hard.

Defaulting to less shiny colors should be fine for now?

Yeah sure.

We just need to give this slider a little more love one day. This is still by far the most complex widget we have.
So what do we do here? Use less funny colors and black/gray only in default.css? If so create a new issue for 1.0.0 with clear goals. And close this one
I'll work on a default theme with @pixelastic; not yet sure what we're gonna do with the default styling of the slider but we'll create a new issue once it's more clear.
